# Project: understudy

## Description
understudy runs Jev-driven stand-ins ("understudies") that play real apps the way a person
would: look at the app, let Jev (TypeSafe) pick one of the moves the app offers, make it,
until the part's statechart reaches its end. Authors write a **part** (YAML statechart +
TypeSafe questions) and a small **adapter**; understudy supplies the run loop, the targets
(command-line `process`, headless-Chromium `page`) and load-time checking. For automation
authors testing their apps, and for recard, which will consume it as a git dependency
(`github:drusifer/understudy#<tag>`). Lifted out of recard's game harness in sprint 1
(see `docs/EXTRACTION_MAP.md`).

**Status:** sprint 1 "MVP first run" done and merged to `main` (766a47c). Release tag `v0.1.0` exists but points at the initial commit (66ce717) - the owner is to move it to 766a47c.
Next: `docs/BACKLOG.md` (HTTP target, recard migration).

## Capabilities

### via
```
via: enabled
```
- When `enabled`: all personas use `via` for code navigation before falling back to Grep/Glob/Read.
- When `disabled`: personas use standard file and shell tools.

### Other capabilities
```
bobp: enabled            # every project task goes through `bobp make <target>`; team chat via `bobp chat`
typesafe-jev: enabled    # live runs need TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the environment; each Jev decision is a paid call
chromium: enabled        # Playwright 1.62.1's bundled Chromium (~/.cache/ms-playwright), /usr/bin/chromium fallback
gitleaks: enabled        # `bobp make secrets`, part of `bobp make check`; pre-commit hook via `bobp make hooks`
```

## Project Standards
- **Toolchain:** Node 24 ESM (`.mjs` in src/, bin/, examples/), npm + committed `package-lock.json`,
  `node:test`, eslint (recommended + unicorn + sonarjs). Source of truth: `docs/SDLC.md` (Tank).
- **Always `bobp make <target>`** — never bare `make`, `npm`, `node bin/understudy.mjs` or
  `npx` for project tasks. Run the command as `bobp make run ARGS="run|check|library ..."`.
- **Always `bobp chat`** for team communication and progress; never hand-edit `agents/CHAT.md`.
- **Gates:** `bobp make test` and `bobp make lint` before any handoff; `bobp make check` at
  sprint close. `bobp make test` must never call Jev or launch Chromium (ADR-0006) — inject a
  judge double / fake target; live runs only via `bobp make test-live` at UAT.
- **Errors:** `UsageError` (exit 2, refused before starting) vs `RunError` (exit 1, with an
  `outcome`); one `understudy: <message>` line, no stack traces (ADR-0005).
- **Vocabulary:** app / target / adapter / part / OBSERVE / look / phase — no card-table words
  (table, game, bot) in src/ or docs (ADR-0003).
- **Parts:** question prose names state by path in backticks, never a number or quoted value.
- **Branching:** each sprint on `sprint-<N>`; agents commit once per reviewed phase, never
  push, merge or tag without the owner asking (SDLC §6).
- **Commit + push:** `bobp make push MSG="..."` does the whole thing (gate → stage → secret scan
  → commit → push current branch + tags); `ARGS="--dry-run"` previews. Run it only when the owner
  asks; it is pre-approved in `.claude/settings.local.json`.
